answer: Sybil resistance starts at the network vertex. Each epoch three independent observers time a candidate's round trips and file the signature in a shared vault. Profiles within 8 ms of an existing entry collapse into one oasis, and an oasis carries exactly one vote. An honest agent alone on its host is a vertex with full weight. A farm renting 250 proxies from one provider files 250 probes but occupies one oasis, earning one vote while paying 250 lines, so each counted voice costs 250 times an honest agent's. Entries decay unless fresh signed probes return.
